decision: Landlord elected to use her own contractor and reported the repair complete on 19/06/25 (event-007, event-012), so there is no agency dispatch, spend or quote to arrange. Two gaps remained: the tenant was never told the outcome (last contact event-004), and the ticket record's address conflicts with the address the tenant herself gave in reply to our question (event-009), which changes which property was repaired. I notified the tenant and asked her to confirm the pipe is actually fixed (ACT-1), referred the address conflict to the office rather than picking a side with any party (ACT-2, per rule on conflicting agency records / ESC-CONFLICT), logged the review (ACT-3) and placed the ticket on hold Waiting for Tenant (ACT-4). Not closed: closure needs the tenant's confirmation and a corrected property record.
recap: Loose garden water pipe; landlord's own contractor reported it done 19/06/25 — tenant now asked to confirm, address conflict referred to the office, ticket on hold.
hold_reason: Waiting for Tenant — confirmation that the back-garden pipe was repaired by the landlord's contractor; office in parallel to resolve the address conflict. 3-day reply window.

facts.statement: Tenant reported on 16/06/2025 that the water pipe in the back garden had become loose, with a photo attached.
The report contains no emergency indicator: no leak, flooding, water near electrics, loss of water supply or sewage backing up is described anywhere in the artefacts.
The agency acknowledged to the tenant on 18/06/2025 that the request had gone to the landlord for a decision; this is the last contact with the tenant before today.
The landlord (Grace Oakley) replied on 18/06/2025 'We will sort this issue', i.e. she is using her own contractor; no agency instruction or spend was authorised.
The landlord confirmed on 03/07/2025 'All completed on 19/06/25'; the agency logged landlord confirmation and marked the task completed without payment.

The ticket record and all agency emails give the property as Flat 7, 87 Alder Lane, Bellmere, ZZ3 8ZZ; the tenant, answering the agency's own question 'please confirm the full address', gave Flat 7, 177 Alder Lane, Northbridge, ZZ6 5ZZ.
No landlord standing spend cap is on file in this case record, so there is no standing authority for agency spend; none was needed as the landlord used her own contractor.
No photos, contractor report or invoice are held by the agency; the referenced attachment (attachment-17-document) is unavailable.

conflicts.description: Property address: ticket record and agency correspondence say Flat 7, 87 Alder Lane, Bellmere, ZZ3 8ZZ; the tenant's own confirmation on the same thread says Flat 7, 177 Alder Lane, Northbridge, ZZ6 5ZZ. The difference changes which property the landlord's contractor attended and whether the completed repair matches the reporting tenant.
conflicts.resolution: Referred to the office via human task ACT-2; no address asserted to any party. Tenant asked only whether her pipe is repaired.

red_flags.description: Two agency records give different property addresses for the same ticket (event-009 vs the ticket record); also the forwarded email names 'Theo Oakley' as the sender of a message signed 'Felix', so names in message bodies are unreliable and were not copied into any party letter.
